why: This file is an INPUT, not a run artifact. Every other *-config.json in this
directory was written BY a harness; this one is read by one. It exists because
configurations.md records temperature as a hidden variable that confounded an
entire prior series: each harness hard-coded a value, and one of them set 0.8
by vibe. A value that lives in code is a value nobody reviewed. So the sampling
table -- temperature, thinking mode and max_tokens, per role per arm -- lives
here, and examples/arch_arms.py defines no fallback for any of it: a missing
cell raises rather than quietly becoming 0.3.
Model identities live here too, and for a second reason: the cortex is being
upgraded to a vision-capable model as this lands. A model id hard-coded in a
harness would name a mind that no longer exists, and arm E would silently
measure the wrong rig. Its 'model' is null on purpose -- see roles.cortex.why.
NULL DELIBERATELY. The rig's cortex is mid-upgrade to a vision-capable
model, so no id can be pinned honestly today. Absence is not a default:
arch_arms resolves the id from EMBODIMENT_CORTEX_MODEL or the --cortex-model
flag, and with neither it records the arm ABSENT rather than substituting a
predecessor. Arm E is therefore NOT 'the rig we already measured' -- the
numbers in arena-budget.md, league-h2h.md and league-commander.md describe a
cortex that will not exist, and are never this series' baseline. E is
re-measured against whatever id is dialled here.
Served on Thor and verified from its own /capabilities advert (spec s1), so
it can be pinned. Dialled DIRECTLY at Thor: the spark gateway advertises no
worker role (spec s2), and examples/worker_seam.py refuses to fall back to
it. These two values are handed to worker_seam.resolve_worker_config as the
explicit operator statement they are; that function still checks the key and
the scheme, and still degrades to a recorded ABSENT rather than substituting.
Constant in every arm, and NOT DIALLED by the text-only challenge rungs --
recorded so the configuration is complete, exactly as league_h2h records
SENSES_MODEL for a seat that has no senses lane. It is hashed rather than
merely written down: arch_arms refuses to run when any two arms' senses
configuration differs, and every per-call record carries the hash, so the
invariant is checkable from a committed artifact alone. The hash starts
biting on real traffic when the perception-routing rung dials senses.
What 'thinking: on' actually puts on the wire, stated here rather than
assumed in code. The convention differs across servers and model families,
and the upgraded cortex's is not yet known -- a harness that hard-coded one
would be inventing a fact about a model nobody has dialled. A mode with no
entry here is a config error, never a silent no-op; an entry of {} is an
explicit 'send no extra keys'.
Per role PER ARM, because 'the same value for both minds' is precisely the
mistake configurations.md records. temperature 0.3 follows the operator's
stated heuristic (0.1-0.3 for correctness work); every rung on this ladder is
a correctness task. max_tokens 16000 is d16: t24 measured the shipped 2048
default truncating 6.0% of completions with ZERO degradations recorded,
because ModelResponse carries no finish_reason (#37). Both acting minds are
thinking models, so the budget is sufficient rather than merely equal and cost
is read off tokens actually consumed.
Drive budgets, not sampling -- but config for the same reason. They are
SUFFICIENT rather than equal: the loop charges every child turn to the
parent's max_steps, so an orchestrated arm needs headroom for the same ground
work PLUS the orchestration turns around it. Capping M and H at the flat arms'
14 would measure the budget, not the architecture. Fairness in cost terms is
recovered by reporting turns and tokens actually consumed, which is the
sufficient-not-equal doctrine league-h2h-preregistration.md already fixed.
ADDITIVE to t5's table, and read by a different harness. The perception-
routing rung (deviation d1) varies HOW an image reaches the deciding mind,
orthogonally to the architecture factor. The original vision-rung design
assumed a text-only cortex, so the rung was an asymmetry: the worker could
see and the cortex could not. That premise died when the cortex was upgraded
mid-build and its vision was measured (cortex-vision-probe.md), so what is
left is a routing question -- does the senses role still earn its place on
visual input once the deciding mind can see?
Each route states EXACTLY what each mind receives, in the closed vocabulary
below, and examples/arch_vision.py asserts the payload it builds against
this declaration rather than merely reading it back. A declaration nobody
checks is a comment.

content_vocabulary.question: the rung's question text, identical on every route
content_vocabulary.map-image: the fog-scoped map PNG as an OpenAI image_url content part
content_vocabulary.senses-description: the senses role's prose description of that same PNG
content_vocabulary.describe-instruction: the fixed instruction handed to the senses role

why: A two-stage screen, per c41. Stage 1 runs the three routes on the FLAT arm
alone; stage 2 carries ONLY the route stage 1 selected into the four
architectures. A full 4x3 crossing is refused BY RULE rather than by
budget: 12 cells at achievable n cannot resolve an interaction, which is
how t18 and t19 died. run_stage2 takes no route argument at all -- it
re-derives the route from the stage-1 artifact -- so a post-hoc pick after
seeing stage-2 data is not a discouraged practice but an unexpressible one.
Committed BEFORE any measured dial, tie-breaks included, because a rule
that only covers the case where the data separates is a rule that hands
the tied case back to judgement. Primary axis is correctness. A tie falls
to total tokens (the cheapest route wins), then to a fixed precedence:
fewest minds and fewest content parts first, since each one is a failure
mode the rig would have to carry forever. Only a correctness win is
reported as a separation; a tie-broken pick is recorded as a tie-broken
pick and must never be quoted as 'route X won'.
min_attempts_per_route is the floor for a screen to be gradeable at all --
one full pass of the rung. The measured n is task t11's to pin.
c40/h31. The information-matching rule (c22/h16) exists so an image cell
cannot smuggle extra state past its text twin. Routing arms deliberately
vary information content -- a senses description is lossy compression of
the image by design -- so matching would forbid the very contrast this
rung measures. The exemption is stated PER RUNG, relaxes matching ONLY,
and the fog-scoping rule keeps binding every route unchanged: no route
may show a mind a cell its visibility excludes. arch_vision refuses to
load a config that tries to widen this.
c43/h32. The gateway advert UNDERSTATES the cortex: its responsibilities
list carries no image_understanding, yet the cortex demonstrably reads
image parts. A consumer obeying this repo's own 'resolve by name, never
parse model names' rule would conclude the deciding mind is blind and
silently drop the native route. So this rung's capability facts come from
committed measured probes and never from the advert, for as long as the
two disagree. If the advert is corrected the probes stay as the record of
what was true when the design was fixed.
The image goes straight to the deciding mind as an image part. This is
the route the advert would have made us drop; it is dialable only
because the vision probe measured it working with a guess-proof
control. Zero senses calls -- which is the whole point of the screen.
Today's shape: the senses role sees the image and the deciding mind
reads only text. Lossy by construction -- that loss is the variable,
not a defect, and it is why this rung is exempt from information
matching.
The description AND the native image. The most expensive route and the
only one that could show a description helping a mind that can already
see -- which is the outcome that would keep senses on the visual path.
PROVISIONAL, and named as such. The pre-registration (task t11) is the
authority on the ladder, the decision rule and the stop rule; it is not
committed yet, and t5 must not pre-empt it. The rule lives here as data so
t11 can pin or amend it without a code change -- analyse() reads these
numbers, it does not carry them.
